decisions.reason: It remained on the site beyond launch and extends the firm's sensor platform into a still-valuable application area, so the low cost of keeping the option open outweighs early abandonment.
Because it is a 3.0 replacement for an earlier voltage measurement module, it likely serves proven demand in the core system and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
A CAN bus interface is a useful ecosystem complement for industrial users, and with no sign of an immediate failure the firm would usually retain such a low-carrying-cost option.
The CO2 sensor stayed listed after launch and fits the established sensor-module business, so its option value remains positive unless later evidence shows persistently weak sales.
